title: policy/evaluator-conditions.json
description: The committed fixed conditions of every run of an evaluation (AD-7): the model a run uses (and, when the contract declares a rubric, the model its judge uses), which tea-evaluate run writes into each run's EvaluatorConfiguration beside the sealedBriefDigest it takes from seal. An evaluation in which no model runs anywhere (target, evaluator and judge) leaves this file out, and the run records modelSnapshot none and a systemPromptDigest over the empty byte string. When the judge is the only model, the file carries modelSnapshot none, that digest (sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855, which tea-evaluate check requires beside none) and the judge block. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

modelSnapshot.description: The model the run uses, as its vendor names the exact snapshot, held as a fixed condition of every run (NFR8). The literal none says the run uses no model.

systemPromptDigest.description: eval-quality's digestBytes over the system prompt that model runs under: sha256: and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

evaluator.description: The sealed-brief-agent evaluator's fixed condition, required when evaluation.json's evaluator is that kind: the model snapshot its agent runs, which each run records as its EvaluatorConfiguration's modelSnapshot beside the digest of the runtime's evaluator instruction template. The top-level modelSnapshot and systemPromptDigest (the target's model, when it runs one) are then recorded under decodingParameters tea.targetModelSnapshot and tea.targetSystemPromptDigest, so neither condition is lost.

modelSnapshot.description: The evaluator agent's model, as its vendor names the exact snapshot.

judge.description: The rubric judge's fixed condition, required when the contract declares a rubric: the model snapshot evaluation.json's judge runs, which each run records in its EvaluatorConfiguration's judgeConfiguration beside the digest of the runtime's judge instruction template.

modelSnapshot.description: The judge's model, as its vendor names the exact snapshot.
